description: This file defines the OrderProductDownload entity class, representing downloadable product details within an order in an e-commerce system. It includes annotations for JPA entity mapping, fields for download metadata, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: OrderProductDownload
classes.description: Entity class representing downloadable information associated with an ordered product, including filename, download count, and allowed days for download.

methods.name: OrderProductDownload
methods.description: Default constructor for the OrderProductDownload entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the download record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the download record.

methods.name: getOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the downloadable product.

methods.name: setOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the downloadable product.

methods.name: getMaxdays
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum days allowed for download.

methods.name: setMaxdays
methods.description: Sets the maximum days allowed for download.
